bearerAuth.description: A dashboard sign-in access token, or a management token (fbm_...) for operations that accept one. Management tokens are limited to forms, fields, allowed origins, publication, and public form tokens, and to the actions their grants allow.

secret.description: The full token. It is returned only once and cannot be retrieved again.

put.description: The workspace owner's account email, or an address already confirmed for the form, becomes the primary recipient at once. Any other address is emailed a confirmation link and returned with replacesPrimary set; the current primary keeps receiving until it is confirmed.
